questions.q: In the following series of reactions identify the major products A and B respectively (bromobenzene -> SO3/H2SO4 -> A -> Br2/Fe -> B).
questions.explain: MARKS key: Br is o/p directing, so sulfonation goes para (A). Then Br2/Fe: the new Br goes ortho to Br and meta to SO3H - both directors agree - giving option B's product.

questions.q: Given below are two statements: Statement I: Nitration of benzene involves the following step (see image). Statement II: Use of Lewis base promotes the electrophilic substitution of benzene. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer.
options: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
questions.explain: MARKS key: The nitrating mixture protonates HNO3, which loses water to give NO2+. Lewis ACIDS (not bases) promote electrophile formation.

questions.q: Which of the following compound will most easily be attacked by an electrophile?
questions.explain: MARKS key: -OH donates by resonance and activates the ring most strongly; -CH3 is a weaker activator, Cl deactivates.
